name: reference_design_fidelity

test_list.description: Reference header x4/y2, version/path in one line, hero separated from the exact greeting, footer last row.
Thin full-width top/bottom rules; black editor; muted placeholder; marker/text inset match dist.
Logical and wrapped rows grow up to floor(height*3/8), preserving draft/caret on resize.
North Star uses per-glyph mint center, green adjoining rays and gray tips.
Opaque black completion follows selection beyond the first page and uses foreground focus only.
Black fine-outline sheet with distinct title separator and footer that does not overwrite its bottom border.
Optional exact Ratatui SVG/plain captures at 60x20, 80x24, 100x30, 120x40 and 160x60; no fabricated terminal screenshot.
Explicit ANSI and terminal themes preserve visible placeholder, mode and command-focus semantic foregrounds while keeping inherited/black surfaces.
User and assistant messages use neutral text without You/Polaris captions; submitted prompts retain #141414, while errors retain explicit labels.

inputs.name: screen
inputs.description: Actual screen state painted through deterministic test backend at reference matrix sizes.

output_description: Reference geometry, semantic color, caret and viewport evidence; not a physical terminal screenshot.
